notes:
Lead source: inbound contact form (site). Product fit: small SaaS customer support platform (chat widget + KB) — wants to replace current generative layer with Redwood hosted API for faster onboarding and predictable billing.

Initial discovery call (2026-03-03) — Maya + Diego. Key things captured: 
- Primary ask: hosted_api, self-serve with quick onboarding. Low ops overhead.
- Traffic profile: expected 30k-60k messages/month in first 6 months; spikes during product launches (burst to ~200 req/min).
- Latency SLO: p95 < 300ms end-to-end for user-facing chat (acceptable to degrade to 500ms during bursts).
- Cost sensitivity: startup budget, wants cost predictability; interested in token-based usage + basic cost controls.
- Model preferences: open models preferred (privacy + cost). Asked about Redwood model catalog and quantized variants.

Privacy & retention discussion (heavy):
- "Do you store prompts?" -> customer legal: wants option for user-level opt-out so transcripts/prompts not retained for those users.
- Concerned about logs: wants 7-day default retention for request/response logs, with ability to purge on demand for opted-out users.
- Audit requirements: need audit log showing purge requests + confirmation for compliance.
- Data residency: currently NA-only; flagged but not a blocker (may revisit if Europe expansion).

Security eval steps proposed:
- Send Redwood hosted retention FAQ + sample contract clause for non-persistent data option. (Action: Maya)
- Provide screenshot of Console showing retention controls and deletion endpoints. (Action: Diego)
- Legal to review sample clause; want clear SLA on purge timing (48-72 hours) and confirmation artifact.

POC plan: 2-week POC using hosted_api sandbox keys. Goal: integrate chat widget, validate latency and switching between cached vs no-cache modes for privacy-sensitive sessions. Success metric: under 300ms p95 in sandbox for typical sessions, ability to trigger on-demand purge for test user.

Recent timeline (bulleted):
- 2026-02-20: Inbound contact form (trial interest).
- 2026-02-25: Auto-response + onboarding link sent.
- 2026-03-03: Discovery call (Fireflies ff_20260303_0012).

Quotes / paraphrases: 
- Customer PO: "We need a clear opt-out for our end users — marketing can't accidentally send PII into the model and keep it forever."
- CTO (product): "If we can flip a flag and guarantee no storage for certain sessions, we can roll Redwood into beta next month."

Open questions for Redwood product/Legal: 
- Can hosted tier support per-session non-persistence toggle today or do we need a workaround (short retention + purge API)?
- What confirmation artifact can we provide when a purge completes (audit id)?
